quests.name: Cull the Wolves
quests.text: Wolves have taken three ewes off the common this month, and the dog that went after them. The reeve pays on five pelts.
quests.outcome: The reeve counts the pelts twice and pays.

quests.name: The Mirefen Lantern
quests.text: My girl followed the marsh-lights into Mirefen with a lantern her father made. Bring back the lantern, or word of where it lies.
quests.outcome: You bring the lantern home, glass cracked, wick still dry. Wenna presses her prayer beads into your hand.

quests.name: The Alpha of Whisperwood
quests.text: The wolves do not leave Whisperwood by chance. Something drives them. The lodge pays well for the head of the grey alpha the woodcutters call Grimfang.
quests.outcome: The lodge nails the head above its door and hands you the best bow on its wall.

quests.name: Trolls Under the Causeway
quests.text: Bog trolls have come up out of Mirefen and squat under the old causeway, taking their toll in flesh. Kill three and the carters will run again.
quests.outcome: The first cart over the causeway in a season carries your payment.

quests.name: Cold Lights in the Glade
quests.text: Grave wraiths dance with the fae in Elderglade now, and the dancers do not come home. Put four of them back in the ground.
quests.outcome: The priests ring the temple bell once for each of them, then pay you.

quests.name: The Long Watch
quests.text: Our grandparents' grandparents swore to keep watch on the Highcrag seal. If your house means to break it, come back and tell us the day it falls.

objective.label: Bring word when the Highcrag seal breaks

quests.outcome: The elders ring a bell no one alive has heard, and write your name beside the oath.

quests.name: Goblin Ears
quests.text: The warrens breed faster than we can kill them. The guild pays on six goblin ears, left or right, no haggling.
quests.outcome: The guild clerk tips the ears into a barrel without looking and counts out the coin.

quests.name: Survey of the Deep Halls
quests.text: Deepstone was dwarf-held before the long silence. The Hall wants someone to walk down to the first gate and come back to say what they saw.

objective.label: Walk down to the first gate of Deepstone Halls

quests.outcome: The surveyors copy your account into the Hall's ledger and pay you in mail from the old armouries.

quests.name: Ogres on the Ore Road
quests.text: Hill ogres have learned that the ore carts carry iron and the carters carry meat. Four dead ogres and the road opens again.
quests.outcome: The smiths pay in coin still warm from the forge.

quests.name: Golems in the Scree
quests.text: Stone golems have woken in the high scree and in the deep halls both. Their cores ring like bells under a hammer. Bring the guild three.
quests.outcome: The guild sets the cores on the anvil and the whole street stops to listen.

quests.name: The Warden's Key
quests.text: The rite names a key cut in Deepstone, in the forge at the bottom of the halls. If it still hangs there, bring it up. Nothing else in the world will turn that lock.

objective.label: Recover the key from the forge in Deepstone Halls

quests.outcome: The key is black iron, cold enough to burn. The Hall sends it to Kingshold under guard.

quests.name: The Barrow Dead
quests.poster: The Captain of the Kingshold Watch
quests.text: The dead of Hollow Barrow have started walking the north road at night. The Watch pays for six of them put down for good.
quests.outcome: The captain has the bones burned in the square and pays from the Watch chest.

quests.name: The King Beneath the Barrow
quests.text: The thing in Hollow Barrow wears a crown older than Kingshold. The Archive wants it laid to rest, and will open its vaults to whoever does it.

objective.label: Lay the Hollow King to rest

echo.text: {heir} laid the Hollow King to rest

quests.outcome: The Archivist unlocks a vault no one has opened in a lifetime and hands you a staff older than the city.

quests.name: The White Pack
quests.poster: The Captain of the Kingshold Watch
quests.text: Frost wolves came down out of Frostreach in the last hard winter and stayed. Five pelts. White ones.
quests.outcome: The pelts go to line the captain's cloak. The coin goes to you.

quests.name: The Sealed Road
quests.text: Past Highcrag a road runs into the rock and ends at a wall of black glass. The wardens hear something on the far side. Go and look at the seal, and tell us if it holds.
quests.outcome: The glass is cracked from the inside. The wardens send riders to Brinehaven, where the old rite was kept.

quests.name: Break the Seal
quests.text: The key is cut and the rite is known. The wardens will work the seal, but not while beasts hold the passes. Kill six of them on the high road and the wardens will follow.

objective.label: Clear {count} beasts from the Highcrag passes

echo.text: {heir} opened the road to the Rift

quests.outcome: At dawn the wardens turn the key. The black glass splits from top to bottom, and the road past Highcrag runs on into the Rift.

quests.name: Hold the Rift's Mouth
quests.text: What comes out of the Rift does not stay in it. The wardens pay for every four of them that never reach Highcrag.
quests.outcome: The wardens tally the kills on the wall of the gatehouse. The wall is nearly full.

quests.name: The Thing Behind the Seal
quests.text: Every warden who has walked the Rift comes back with the same word: something waits at the bottom, and it is waking. The crown will give anything to the house that ends it.

objective.label: Destroy the Unmade in the Rift

quests.outcome: Every bell in Kingshold rings at once. The crown pays in gold, and in a feather that is still warm.

quests.name: Wreckers on the Strand
quests.text: Someone lights false lamps on the strand and strips whatever washes up. They are no fishermen. Five of them, and the harbour pays.
quests.outcome: The harbourmaster has the lamps smashed and pays you from the dock tolls.

quests.name: The Drowned Bell
quests.text: At low tide the bell of the Sunken Temple still rings, though it has no rope and no ringer. The Chapter wants to know who rings it.

objective.label: Find who rings the bell of the Sunken Temple

quests.outcome: No one rings it. The Chapter writes that down too, and pays you with a locket from its own treasury.

quests.name: Imps in the Sulphur Works
quests.text: The sulphur diggers on Emberpeak's flank have downed tools. Fire imps nest in the workings. Kill five and the powder ships sail again.
quests.outcome: The diggers go back up the mountain singing. The harbour pays.

quests.name: The Drake in the Mountain
quests.text: Vaerthax burned four ships in the roads last summer and sleeps fat in Emberpeak's throat. The merchant houses have pooled a bounty, and the scales of the last drake anyone killed.

echo.text: {heir} slew the drake that burned Brinehaven's ships

quests.outcome: The merchant houses pay in gold and in a coat of dragonscale, cut to your measure.

quests.name: The Drowned Rite
quests.text: The rite that sealed the Rift was cut into the walls of the Sunken Temple when the temple still stood on dry land. Go down and read it, if the water lets you.

objective.label: Read the rite on the walls of the Sunken Temple

quests.outcome: You come up with the rite copied on your arm in charcoal. It names a key cut in Deepstone, and the Chapter sends word to Ironford.

quests.name: Soundings of the Rift
quests.text: The Chapter has charted every drowned thing on this coast. Now it wants the Rift charted. Walk in, mark what you see, and walk out again.

objective.label: Walk into the Rift and come back out

echo.text: {heir} charted the Rift for the Chapter

quests.outcome: Your chart of the Rift goes into the Chapter's vault. No two of its copyists draw it the same way.
